note: Renewal rules shown in the phone wallet. act_by = expires_at - act_by_days. Stage: lapsed when today > expires_at; urgent when today >= act_by - urgent_days; window_open when today >= act_by - remind_days; ok otherwise; unknown with no date. Every value carries a flag: verified = checked against the linked primary source on as_of; assumption = our demo choice, shown with an assumption tag. Muster never computes Nadcap merit tiers and never marks a shop-entered date as verified.

rules.label: Controlled Goods Program (CGP)
rules.text: Registration lasts up to 5 years. File renewal at least 90 days before expiry. Processing takes up to 32 business days. If it lapses you must re-register from scratch.
rules.consequence: A lapsed registration means re-registering from scratch, and controlled jobs (and their technical data) can't go to you in the meantime.

sources.supports: renew at least 90 days before expiry; up to 32 business days; a lapse means re-registering

sources.label: canada.ca: CGP register (modified 2026-03-11)

rules.label: CPCSC Level 1
rules.text: Annual self-assessment against 13 controls using the official tool. Always shop-declared; there is no public registry.
rules.consequence: Jobs that require CPCSC Level 1 can't be routed to you until the self-assessment is current.

sources.label: PSPC news: Canadian Program for Cyber Security Certification Level 1 (2026-04)

rules.label: AS9100
rules.act_by_note: Assumption: book the recertification audit about 90 days before the certificate expires.
rules.text: Certificate up to 3 years with annual surveillance audits.
rules.consequence: Jobs that require AS9100 can't be routed to you once the certificate lapses.

sources.label: PRI Registrar: general policies and procedures, certification
sources.supports: certificate up to 3 years; annual surveillance audits

rules.label: ISO 9001
rules.act_by_note: Assumption: book the recertification audit about 90 days before the certificate expires.
rules.text: 3-year certification cycle with annual surveillance (assumption: same cycle as AS9100). Check on IAF CertSearch.
rules.consequence: Jobs that require ISO 9001 can't be routed to you once the certificate lapses.

sources.label: IAF CertSearch (lookup only; the cycle length is an assumption)

rules.label: Nadcap
rules.act_by_note: Assumption: schedule the reaccreditation audit about 90 days before expiry.
rules.text: Read the expiry off the certificate (typically 12–24 months). Muster does not compute merit tiers.
rules.consequence: Jobs that require this Nadcap accreditation can't be routed to you once it lapses.

sources.label: PRI: Getting started with a Nadcap accreditation
sources.supports: periodic reaccreditation audits, typically every 12–24 months; audits managed in PRI EAN (formerly eAuditNet)

rules.label: CWB W47.1 (company)
rules.act_by_note: No fixed renewal date: company certification is kept current through CWB audits. With a shop-declared date, Muster counts to that date.
rules.text: Company certification kept current through CWB audits. Check the CWB certified-company directory.
rules.consequence: Jobs that require CWB W47.1 can't be routed to you, and your welders' tickets are only valid at a CWB-certified company.

sources.label: CWB: CSA W47.1 fusion welding of steel (company certification)
sources.supports: company certification; supervisor, WPS, engineer by division, tested welders, audits

sources.label: CWB: validating certification
sources.supports: a wall certificate alone is not proof; check the directory

rules.label: CWB welder ticket
rules.text: Valid 2 years while continuously employed by a CWB-certified company. Check test from 90 days before to 90 days after expiry; after that, a full retest. May lapse after 3 months without using the process (confirm on the welder's card).
rules.consequence: After the 90-day grace period a full retest is needed.
rules.flag_note: The 3-month non-use rule is INFERRED from card text.

sources.label: CWB: welder qualification testing
sources.supports: 2 years while employed at a certified company; check test within 90 days either side of expiry (3-month rule: inferred)
